title: We made a game for relaxing after a long day
author: syncope33
selftext:
We made a Burning Star which is a cozy exploration adventure set in the world of Lumia, where you'll meet little creatures called Lumis that can transform into other creatures to help you explore, solve puzzles and find your way around.  
  
Pretty much, we wanted the perfect game that lets you chill after a hard day's work, something extremely low stress that gives a feeling of joyfulness and serenity.  
  
There's still plenty of work to do, but we're really happy with how it's coming along and excited to finally start sharing more of it!

We've used Hyper3D to help with 3d models and textures and Opus 5.5 for development.

Ofcourse, we still need to polish these but I'm really excited with the results so far.



Let me know what you think and drop a wishlist on Steam if you like it <3
